tools.name: add_opportunity_line_item
tools.description: Adds a product (line item) to an opportunity. The product must exist in a pricebook entry that's associated with the opportunity's pricebook.

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: Discount percentage (0-100). Cannot be used with TotalPrice.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: The quantity of the product to add.
quantity.human_parameter_description: How many units of the product you want to add. Enter a number like 1, 5, or 10.

unit_price.title: Unit Price
unit_price.description: The sales price per unit. Provide either unit_price or total_price — Salesforce does NOT auto-fill the price from the pricebook entry on insert, and omitting both fails with FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description for this line item.
description.human_parameter_description: Optional notes about this line item to help teammates or the customer understand what’s included.

total_price.title: Total Price
total_price.description: The total price for this line item. Cannot be used with UnitPrice or Discount.
total_price.human_parameter_description: The full amount you want to charge for this line item. Use this when you know the total; don’t combine with unit price or discount.

service_date.title: Service Date
service_date.description: Service date for the product in YYYY-MM-DD format.
service_date.human_parameter_description: The date the service is delivered or the product is used. Enter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.

opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

opportunity_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity you want to add this product to. Paste the record ID (usually starts with 006) for that specific opportunity.

pricebook_entry_id.title: Pricebook Entry Id
pricebook_entry_id.description: The ID of the PricebookEntry that contains the product and price information. This links to a specific product in a specific pricebook. tools.name: run_soql_query
tools.description: Executes a SOQL SELECT query against Salesforce data and returns a page of matching records with pagination information. Queries using FIELDS(ALL) or FIELDS(CUSTOM) are limited to 200 records.

query.title: Query
examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use salesforce.get_all_fields_for_object for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.
query.human_parameter_description: The SOQL statement to run against your Salesforce data. Write the query that selects and filters the records you want to retrieve.
